summary: Frontend-only re-test of the reported 'translation output not scrollable' bug on the demo build (Shadow DOM Panel). BUG IS NOT FIXED. On ?v=long at 1280x600 the scroll container [data-testid="grh-panel"] .grh-body reports scrollHeight == clientHeight (388 == 388), so no scrollbar exists and the Ukrainian/Turkish/Chinese rows are clipped and unreachable (mouse wheel over the body produced scrollTop=0; programmatic scrollTo also stayed at 0). Root cause isolated and verified by live CSS injection. Regression checks on normal / grammar / compact variants all PASS.

ui_bugs.issue: Long translation content is clipped and unreachable. .grh-body correctly has flex:1 1 auto; min-height:0; overflow-y:auto, BUT its children (.grh-card) are flex items with default flex-shrink:1 and .grh-card has overflow:hidden. The card is therefore compressed from its natural 711px content height down to 360px and clips its own overflow, so .grh-body's scrollHeight never exceeds clientHeight -> no scrollbar is ever created. Measured: cardHeight=360, cardScrollHeight=711, bodyClientHeight=388, bodyScrollHeight=388, flex-shrink=1, card overflow=hidden. Chinese row ('在中世紀…') is NOT reachable: fullyVisible=false before and after scrolling body to bottom (scrollTop stayed 0); mouse wheel over the body also did nothing.

Minor/robustness: .grh-history is also a flex child of .grh-root with default flex-shrink:1, so once the body scrolls correctly the history block can still be squeezed on very short viewports. Recommend flex: 0 0 auto on .grh-history (and .grh-header) to guarantee they stay pinned at their natural height.

action_items: In /app/extension/src/content/panel-styles.ts add `flex: 0 0 auto;` to `.grh-card` (or `.grh-body > *`) so cards keep their natural content height instead of being shrunk by the flex container. Verified fix (injected live): `.grh-body > * { flex: 0 0 auto; } .grh-card { overflow: visible; }` -> bodyScrollHeight became 741 vs clientHeight 388, scrolling to bottom made the Chinese row fully visible (scrollTop=353).

Because .grh-card uses overflow:hidden only to clip its rounded corners, replace it with `overflow: clip` on the header/rounded parts or keep overflow:hidden ONLY after flex-shrink is disabled — with flex-shrink:0 alone the clipping no longer hides content (re-verify).
Add `flex: 0 0 auto` to `.grh-header` and `.grh-history` so they remain pinned on short viewports.
Re-run the scroll test at viewport 1280x600 on ?v=long and assert body.scrollHeight > body.clientHeight and that the Chinese row is fully inside the body client rect after scrollTo(0, scrollHeight).
critical_code_review_comments: The reported fix only addressed the scroll container (.grh-body) but not its flex children; in a `display:flex; flex-direction:column` container, children shrink by default, which defeats overflow-y:auto. This is the actual cause of the user's clipped-translation report.
There is no data-testid on the scroll container itself; tests must reach it via a CSS class ('.grh-body'). Adding data-testid="panel-body" would make this regression test stable.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (4/5 scenarios pass; the primary scroll bug fix FAILS)

seed_data_creation: None - demo page uses static mocked OpenAI data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test URLs: /grh-demo/index.html (normal, 2 cards), ?v=long (single long translate card - use for scroll test), ?v=grammar (grammar only, 5 bullets), ?v=compact (300px width, .grh-source display:none). Panel is in an OPEN shadow root; Playwright data-testid selectors pierce it. Use viewport 1280x600 to force overflow. Verified in this run: header stays pinned (y=0,h=57) and Recent/history stays pinned (y=444.6) while body scrolls; page itself does not scroll the panel; no console errors; all 4 language labels present in DOM in every translate variant.
rca_of_the_issue: `.grh-body` is `display:flex; flex-direction:column` with `overflow-y:auto; min-height:0` (correct). However `.grh-card` children inherit the default `flex-shrink:1`, so the card is compressed from its natural 711px to the available 360px, and `.grh-card { overflow:hidden }` clips the overflowing text. Consequently the body's content never exceeds its client box (scrollHeight 388 == clientHeight 388) and no scrollbar is generated, leaving Ukrainian/Turkish/Chinese rows visually cut off and unreachable by wheel or programmatic scroll. Reproduce: open ?v=long at 1280x600, evaluate scrollHeight/clientHeight on '[data-testid="grh-panel"] .grh-body'. Mitigation: set `flex: 0 0 auto` on the cards / `.grh-body > *`.
